title: Judgment on Egypt
description: The prophecy of God's judgment on Egypt. Pharaoh Neco's army is defeated by Nebuchadnezzar at the river Euphrates near Carchemish. Jeremiah describes Egypt's shame, the flight of the warriors, and the destruction of Memphis, and how the Lord punishes Amon from No, Pharaoh, the gods of Egypt, and its kings. It concludes with the promise that the land will one day be inhabited again as in days of old.
